title: Xue-Lab-COBI/fdt_code: Fluorescence Diffraction Tomography using Explicit Neural Fields (code)
description: Reconstruction code for the paper Fluorescence Diffraction Tomography using Explicit Neural Fields. FDT reconstructs the three-dimensional refractive index of thick biological samples from diffracted fluorescence images.
